newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania launches 300 bln lei treasury-bill issue.
newsitem.headline: Romania launches 300 bln lei treasury-bill issue.

text.p: Romania's Finance Ministry said on Tuesday it would launch later this week a 300 billion lei issue of 63-day treasury bills to finance part of last year's budget deficit.
It said T-bills annual yield would equal the three-month Bucharest Interbank Bid Rate (BUBID) set five days ahead of the public subscription scheduled for October 3.
Three-month BUBID rate was 50.48 percent on Tuesday.
The T-bills, to be placed by the central bank, can be bought by banks and their corporate clients. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
